tax_model.harvest_source: AUTO from desk parametric_scorecard.json realized_ytd (re-read every render). realized-YTD = harvest_pre_coverage_adj (Apr/May, -$269,141, manual bridge until the desk file covers those months — then auto-zeroed) + the live file-covered net loss; daily rate = live net loss / coverage days. The hardcoded harvest_realized_ytd/harvest_daily_rate are FALLBACKs used only if the file read fails.
tax_model.note: User-CONFIRMED character = LT capital gain (2026-07-10; structurally true — founder-stock basis $35). Rate 37.1% (20 fed + 3.8 NIIT + 13.3 CA). Harvest offset uses a PROGRESSION: full-year 2026 harvest = realized-YTD (-$431,187) + current daily rate (-$6,482/day, from the file-verified 25d window) x days to 2026-12-31. Both the gain and the losses fall in tax-year 2026, so the full-year harvest offsets. CAVEAT: linear projection assumes the pace holds — harvesting DECAYS as the book ages (current harvestable surface only ~-$90k) and needs fresh market dips to regenerate; treat the projected offset as optimistic. Taxable_fraction 1.0 (basis $35).

scenario_text.playbook_lead: Highest-leverage move (hits the top-3 scenarios at once): deploy the ~{sept_net} net Sept powder into non-tech sleeves — cuts Parametric from {p0}% to {p1}% of invested (at-risk) capital at $0 tax.
scenario_text.liquidity_read: Liquidity is not the risk — concentration is. With no margin/leverage in the book, even a {dd_pct}% crash leaves {worst_access} raisable from cash + marketable holdings alone — many multiples of the {claims} in claims (mortgage + the Sept tax reserve). You are a forced BUYER, not a forced seller: drawdowns are discounts.
scenario_text.liquidity_note: The real tail is magnitude & concentration: Parametric (~40% of assets, tech-tilted) drives most of the worst-case loss, and the tech-wipeout / equity-crash scenarios cluster the damage in one correlated block. The natural hedges — munis, bonds, cash — are small. But the tax reserve is not a fixed claim: a selloff spikes harvesting and shrinks it — in the worst case by ~{thedge}, an automatic cushion (see Microstructure below).
scenario_text.foot: Scenario shocks are CALIBRATED estimates applied through the sleeve factor-betas (first-pass, to refine from realized returns). Nominal marks: cash/pending held flat; the 2.5% fixed mortgage held at principal; the tax reserve is scenario-responsive (shrinks as harvesting spikes — see Microstructure). Idiosyncratic overrides (tech, venture, housing, Alphabet) layered on top. Mitigation costs are computed from the account's real exposures. The second-order effects are heuristics, flagged ENCODED (in the numbers) vs NOTED (context). Read-only — never places orders.
